list.name: client
list.label: Client
list.query: SELECT client AS __value, coalesce(NULLIF(MAX(name),''), client) AS __text FROM queries GROUP BY client ORDER BY __text

targets.queryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT domain) AS domains FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(DISTINCT domain) AS domains FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}'

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS queries FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS queries FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}'

targets.queryText: SELECT count(*) AS blocked FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}' AND path = 'BLOCKED'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT count(*) AS blocked FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}' AND path = 'BLOCKED'

targets.queryText: SELECT cast(ts/60 AS INTEGER)*60*1000 AS time, count(*) AS queries FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}' GROUP BY cast(ts/60 AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT cast(ts/60 AS INTEGER)*60*1000 AS time, count(*) AS queries FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}' GROUP BY cast(ts/60 AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time

targets.queryText: SELECT domain, count(*) AS queries, sum(CASE WHEN path='BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}' GROUP BY domain ORDER BY queries DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT domain, count(*) AS queries, sum(CASE WHEN path='BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}' GROUP BY domain ORDER BY queries DESC LIMIT 100

targets.queryText: SELECT domain, count(*) AS blocked FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}' AND path = 'BLOCKED' GROUP BY domain ORDER BY blocked DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT domain, count(*) AS blocked FROM queries WHERE client = '${client}' AND path = 'BLOCKED' GROUP BY domain ORDER BY blocked DESC LIMIT 100
